summary: Infosys Ltd files Form 6-K to report postal ballot voting results for routine director appointments: Diane Enberg Jurgens as Independent Director for a three-year term and Helene Auriol Potier re-appointed for a second five-year term. E-voting ran from April 25 to May 24, 2026, with both resolutions passed by requisite majority. No financial terms, premium, or strategic event involved. This is an ordinary governance item. No special-situation classification applies.
